item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to carry out strikes against port infrastructure facilities, logistics centres in Ukraine, and vessels involved in supporting
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to carry out strikes against port infrastructure facilities, logistics centres in Ukraine, and vessels involved in supporting the AFU. 💥 This afternoon, unmanned aerial vehicles hit the Epicentr logistics centre in Odessa, which was used to store and distribute military-related goods supplied from foreign states to the AFU. 🔥 Moreover, a dry cargo ship en route by sea to the port of Odessa was hit . It was transporting cargo for the AFU. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚓️ Perekop off coast of Seychelles The training ship of the Baltic Fleet Perekop arrived at the port of Victoria of the Republic of Seychelles
item.description: Perekop off coast of Seychelles ⚓️ The training ship of the Baltic Fleet Perekop arrived at the port of Victoria of the Republic of Seychelles for the first time as part of the maritime practice of officer cadets of Russian Navy schools. ▫️ The crew is going to enjoy cultural and sporting events as well as a visit the grave of the compatriot, senior ship's doctor Aleksandr Krupenin. The navigational voyage of the Perekop training ship began in early July and will last until mid-December 2026. The ship will pass about 30 thousand nautical miles. The route comprises four oceans, 14 seas, 23 straits, and 9 bays. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.description: Ukrainian servicemen were captured when sleeping on duty Two AFU militants had to dig up a dugout and gain a foothold in it on order from the command. At night, Russian servicemembers woke them up: 'I finished my shift. I woke up my comrade, told him it was his turn, and went to sleep. Then, I woke up, saw him sleeping next to me. I heard voices near the dugout. Someone shouted for us to surrender. Otherwise, they would threw two grenades,' tells the POW. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Ukrainian servicemen were captured when sleeping on duty

'I finished my shift. I woke up my comrade, told him it was his turn, and went to sleep. Then, I woke up, saw him sleeping next to me. I heard voices near the dugout. Someone shouted for us to surrender. Otherwise, they would threw two grenades,' tells the POW.

item.title: 💬 Increasing effectiveness of armoured armament and hardware taking into account combat experience of special military operation.
item.description: Increasing effectiveness of armoured armament and hardware taking into account combat experience of special military operation. Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation General of the Army Aleksandr Sanchik held a technical conference on improving the design of armoured weapons and motor vehicles as well as testing new systems of active protection against enemy UAVs. 💬 Aleksandr Sanchik noted that the feedback from the troops, organised by manufacturers , makes it possible to quickly solve issues of modernisation of supplied to units weapons and equipment. ❗️ At the same time, repair battalions are creating their own effective innovations . The best of such inventions should be produced at factories. In practical part of the conferences, were presented 👇 ▫️ samples of military motor vehicles, which are employed on the front line in the most effective way, ▫️ defensive aids systems against UAVs of the enemy on different chassis. ➡️ General of the Army Aleksandr Sanchik was informed that after testing at the training ground, anti-drone systems would be sent to the special military operation zone. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ⚡️ Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement of the AFU formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone . 🔥 Combat operations to liberate Khripuny, Grachovka, and Rublenoye in Kharkov region are carried out. The enemy units are also being neutralised near Nesternoye, Shevchenkovo, and Varvarovka (Kharkov region). 📍 Russian troops thwarted two attempts to escape from the encirclement by a group of up to 10 militants close to Nefedovka (Kharkov region). ▪️ More than 50 servicemen, one armoured fighting vehicle, two motor vehicles, one ATV, and one MLRS launcher have been neutralised in the encirclement. 🚩 When expanding the external control zone, Russian troops liberated Petropavlovka and Lozovaya in Kharkov region. 💥 In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade near Svetlichnoye, Kovali, Morozova Dolina, Shapovalovka, Zhukov Yar, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region). 🚩 In Sumy region, Russian units took Mariyno under control during active offensive operations . 💥 Manpower and materiel of an airomobile brigade, a mechanised brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades have been hit near Esman, Kiyanitsa, Vakalovshchina, and Boyaro-Lezhachi (Sumy regio
item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces
continue to tighten the encirclement of the AFU formations
in the north-east of Kharkov region and
expand the external control zone
.
🔥
Combat operations to liberate
Khripuny, Grachovka, and Rublenoye in Kharkov region are carried out. The enemy units are also being neutralised near Nesternoye, Shevchenkovo, and Varvarovka (Kharkov region).
📍
Russian troops
thwarted two attempts to escape from the encirclement
by
a group of up to 10 militants close to Nefedovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
More than 50 servicemen, one armoured fighting vehicle, two motor vehicles, one ATV, and one MLRS launcher have been neutralised in the encirclement.
🚩
When expanding the external control zone,
Russian troops liberated Petropavlovka and Lozovaya in Kharkov region.
💥
In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered
at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade near Svetlichnoye, Kovali, Morozova Dolina, Shapovalovka, Zhukov Yar, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
🚩
In Sumy region, Russian units took Mariyno under control during active offensive operations
.
💥
Manpower and materiel
of an airomobile brigade, a mechanised brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades have been hit near Esman, Kiyanitsa, Vakalovshchina, and Boyaro-Lezhachi (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 245 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, eight motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one MLRS launcher in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade near Glushchenkovo, Andreyevka, Lesnaya Stenka, Chervony Oskol, Grushevka, Yaremovka (Kharkov region), and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, one tank, one U.S.-made MaxxPro armoured vehicle, 14 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade close to Druzhkovka, Slavyansk, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, Nikolayevka, Kramatorsk, Belokuzhminovka, and Chervonozaryanoy (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 160 troops, 26 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
👉

The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation

Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Belozerskoye, Roganskoye, Andreyevka, Novovodyanoye, Sergeyevka, Bokovoye, Veseloye Pole, and Gornyak (Donetsk People's Republic).

units of the 51st Combined Arms Army continue to destroy surrounded AFU formations
in the west and east of the city. Up to 40 militants were neutralised. Over the past 24 hours, the enemy has not attempted to break out of the encirclement.
▪️
In total, up to 415 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence
. Manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, two air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade have been hit close to Vesely Kut, Gavrilovka, Ivanovka, Orly (Dnepropetrovsk region), Granichnoye, Obshcheye, Yegorovka, and Omelnik (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 275 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and five motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line
. A mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Dimitrovo, Orekhov, and Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 35 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and 22 motor vehicles were neutralised.

perational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on transport infrastructure facilities used for the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, workshops and storage facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles and their components as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 152 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four guided aerial bombs, two U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, and 1,222 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

since the beginning of the special military operation,
